title: Implement file-structure drift lens
summary: Parse the canonical file-structure map and add deterministic intended-vs-current drift reporting to audits/graph state.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki audits and graph state expose a deterministic file-structure drift lens that compares intended/current paths and classifies approved migration deltas separately from unexpected drift.
acceptance: `file-structure-map.yaml` is parsed into structured intended/current/delta path data without breaking existing diagram refs.

Audit output can report missing expected paths, unexpected paths, ownership mismatches, deprecated paths, generated/runtime artifacts in source areas, approved migration deltas, and compatibility export gaps.
Current repository reports approved concept-root migration delta without false file-structure failure.
Generated graph/status exposes file-structure drift evidence for downstream UI and validation.
Existing audit profiles and public tool behavior remain compatible.
non_goals: Do not migrate source files to concept roots in this task.
Do not render a new UI surface beyond data needed for downstream consumers.
Do not change public package behavior.

delta.desired: Implement the deterministic drift lens first so later source-root and UI migration tasks can use an evidence-backed intended/current/delta map.
delta.current: Decision and KB/diagram truth are accepted; source and UI migration tasks are intentionally deferred until drift data exists.
